clauses.quote: Unit members on other than traditional calendar shall be on a twelve (12) month pay schedule.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members on other than traditional calendar

clauses.quote: No permanent teacher shall be denied a request for a transfer or reassignment solely because he/she holds a hard-to-fill credential.
Unit members hired by the District after serving, as substitutes for a vacancy/opening shall have their status and salary adjusted retroactively to date of hire, contingent on credential status.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members hired by the District after serving, as substitutes for a vacancy/opening

clauses.quote: Prior to initiating a District-initiated transfer, the District shall seek appropriate volunteers from within the site or department.
the unit member who has the least seniority within the department or site from which a transfer must take place shall be transferred first.
clauses.subject_text: the unit member who has the least seniority within the department or site from which a transfer must take place

clauses.quote: Unit members subject to transfer under this section shall receive priority over unit member-initiated transfer for existing vacant positions for which they are qualified.
clauses.subject_text: Unit members subject to transfer under this section

clauses.quote: Unit members shall not be subject to a District-initiated transfer more than once during a school year.
District-initiated transfers caused by curricular modifications and/or other educationally-related needs of the District and/or affected schools may be recommended at any time.
clauses.subject_text: District-initiated transfers caused by curricular modifications and/or other educationally-related needs of the District and/or affected schools

clauses.quote: Such transfers shall not be arbitrary or capricious
in making such transfers the District shall refer to the criteria in 11.7.3.
A District-initiated transfer shall not result in loss of annual contract salary or any health and welfare benefits negotiated in this Agreement.
Unit members transferred under 11.7.10 above shall be given priority consideration over other unit member-initiated transfers to be returned to the original school site
